verdicts.working: “With a view to” takes a gerund; “reducing” and “improving” are parallel.

working:
In “with a view to”, to is a preposition, so it takes gerunds: “reducing” and “improving”.

Independent check: “With a view to” takes a gerund; “reducing” and “improving” are parallel.
solution: In “with a view to,” the word “to” is a preposition and is followed by gerunds. The parallel forms are “reducing” and “improving.”
